title: Cycle peak smoothing and role fallback canary
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Create a lightweight, testable playbook that smooths cycle-level peak staffing demand and validates a role-fallback canary for critical-path coverage. Background: Recent cycles show high variance in peak FTE demand during final two weeks, causing either scope cutting or risky overtime. We want an operational pattern that (a) proactively smooths peaks using cross-role buffer lanes and elastic deferral, and (b) verifies a controlled fallback where adjacent roles temporarily cover critical tasks as a canary before scaling hiring or contractors. Proposal: 1) Define smoothing rules (soft deferral thresholds, buffered tasks, postponement gating). 2) Implement a canary run in a single initiative: identify 1–2 critical roles, create fallback-role pairings, and run a simulated traffic & staffing model using the Cycle Capacity Simulator. 3) Instrument acceptance metrics and dashboards to measure friction, quality regressions, and cost: peak headcount, scope trimmed, QA failures, customer incidents. 4) Produce a short runbook with decision points and postmortem checklist. Acceptance criteria: - Runbook drafted and reviewed by Eng + SDM + People Ops. - Canary executed across one initiative with at least two fallback pairings. - Simulator shows >=10% reduction in simulated peak headcount or equivalent scope preserved in model. - No production customer incidents attributable to fallback during canary. - Post-canaray retrospective with clear go/no-go recommendation. Success metrics: - Peak FTE variance (baseline vs canary) in simulator. - % tasks deferred vs trimmed. - Time-to-recover for fallback handoffs. - Qualitative feedback from engineers on operational friction. Rollout plan: Week 1: finalize rules & identify initiative; Week 2: configure simulator and run dry-runs; Week 3: live canary; Week 4: retrospective and decision. Artifacts: Confluence PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CYCLE/Peak+Smoothing+Playbook; Simulator scenario: https://dashboard.redwood.ai/capacity/sim/pm-520314; Draft runbook: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/peak-smoothing-playbook
